headlines.title: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
headlines.description: The Senate confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz to lead the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, making her the agency’s first permanent director in more than a year.

headlines.title: Chipotle Removes Jalapeños Tied to Salmonella Outbreak
headlines.description: The CDC now confirms more than 10,000 cases of cyclospora infections across 47 states. It comes as health officials in Minnesota are now investigating a wave of salmonella, with a vast majority of patients having recently eaten jalapeño peppers at Chipotle and other Mexican style restaurants. Chipotle says they “proactively removed” the jalapeños in question and “replaced them” with products from different growers. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños over salmonella concerns
headlines.description: The restaurant chain said it replaced jalapeños with product from other growers. Chipotle reports jalapeños are used in guacamole, pico de gallo and more. Meanwhile, we have new reporting on more cases in that illness linked to lettuce. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: How to Tell if You Have a Healthy Gut (and What to Do if You Don't)
headlines.description: Gut health can impact everything from sleep to the immune system, so Dr. Roshini Raj, associate professor of medicine at NYU Langone Health, shares her recommendations for preserving your gut microbiome. She shares the signs of an unhealthy gut, and what to eat to improve it. Dr. Raj also shares her tips for avoiding cyclosporiasis.

headlines.title: How to Treat Summer Skin Problems, According to a Dermatologist
headlines.description: Summer heat, humidity and sweat can really change the way skin looks and feels. Board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry joins TODAY with different treatments for the most common skin concerns such as dehydration, acne, melasma and more.

headlines.title: Millions of eggs have been recalled due to Salmonella contamination — here’s how to stay safe
headlines.description: A multistate salmonella outbreak linked to eggs has sickened nearly one hundred people. Learn the symptoms, risks, and simple steps to protect your family from infection.

headlines.title: The best rolling backpacks for school, travel and work
headlines.description: We rounded up the best rolling backpacks with multiple compartments to distribute the weight evenly. Shop rolling backpacks from Pottery Barn, Jansport, Rockland and more.

headlines.title: The 100 best face moisturizers tested and ranked, according to editors
headlines.description: We tested more than 135 face moisturizers over 4 months. Shop the 100 best face moisturizers, including top contenders from Cerave, Cetaphil and Glossier.

headlines.title: The best Garmin watches of 2026
headlines.description: I’ve tested nearly all of Garmin’s most popular watches. Here are my favorites, and which ones to shop for runners, fitness and best battery life.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak has expanded to six more states
headlines.description: A massive cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to shredded iceberg lettuce has expanded to an additional six states, according to a source familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños after possible link to salmonella outbreak
headlines.description: The restaurant chain said it had replaced the jalapeños with product from another supplier. More than 100 cases of salmonella have been confirmed in Minnesota.

headlines.title: Michigan reports first two deaths in the cyclosporiasis outbreak
headlines.description: More than 11,000 cases of the foodborne illness have been confirmed in the state and 193 people have been hospitalized since early May.
